case.question: I fish for salmon from a boat. For this week, how good do you expect boat fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

## Recommendation

- **Go to Grand Haven and fish from a boat.** My expected rating is **3 (good)**.
- **Muskegon is the backup, rated 2 (average).** Expect fish at 80-230 ft of water.
- **South Haven and St. Joseph are rated 1 (below average).** Expect slow fishing, with the fish spread out and deep.
- **At Grand Haven, start around 80-110 ft and work out toward 180-220 ft if nothing shows.** Run lines 50-100 ft down, using glow spoons, glow plugs, or green flasher-fly rigs.

## Why

- **Grand Haven was the only port with a good boat report in the latest week:** the Aug 20 report rated boat fishing good, with fish 50-100 ft down in 80-220 ft of water (Grand Haven, 2026-08-20; see the date caveat below).
- **Boats did better than the piers at every port:** the Aug 20 pier reports were slow everywhere (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph, 2025-08-20).
- **I'd expect South Haven and St. Joseph to stay weak:** their Aug 20 boat reports were slow, with fish scattered or found mostly beyond 100 ft (South Haven, St. Joseph, 2025-08-20).
- **Past seasons at similar water temperatures point the same way:** in earlier late-summer weeks near 74 F, Grand Haven boat reports were usually good (Grand Haven, 2024-08-07; 2022-08-10).

## Evidence

**Recent reports** (newest is 2025-08-20, six days before today)
- **Grand Haven (boat, rated 3):** "Salmon action was good, but the fish were scattered." Best fishing was 50-100 ft down in 80-220 ft of water, on glow spoons, glow plugs, and flasher flies (Grand Haven, 2025-08-20).
- **Muskegon (boat, rated 2):** "Boats continued to find decent numbers of salmon." Anglers went from 80-110 ft early to 180-230 ft later, catching fish 50-100 ft down on plugs and green flasher-fly rigs (Muskegon, 2025-08-20).
- **South Haven (boat, rated 0):** "Salmon fishing was slow… The fish were very scattered." Anglers fished from 65 ft out past 120 ft. The only other catch was "a few Chinook" (South Haven, 2025-08-20).
- **St. Joseph (boat, rated 0):** "Boats had been fishing mostly beyond 100 feet of water" and fishing was "unsuccessful" (St. Joseph, 2025-08-20).
- **Trend at Grand Haven:** the Aug 13 boat report was also good, 3 (Grand Haven, 2025-08-13). Muskegon was 2 that week (Muskegon, 2025-08-13). South Haven and St. Joseph were both slow (South Haven and St. Joseph, 2025-08-13).

**Past seasons** (history, not this week's reports)
- In weeks with buoy water near 74 F, Grand Haven boat reports were good in 2024 (3, 2024-08-07) and 2022 (3, 2022-08-10). Muskegon was rated 3 in some of those same weeks.
- South Haven was good in late August 2024 (3, 2024-08-28), but it has been slow in the most recent reports. I'd treat the 2024 result as a sign that it can turn around, not as a forecast.

**Conditions now**
